purpose: Document city-specific first-party registry evidence, service-access limits and bounded public parcel-geometry route review.
assessment: Panipat District Administration documents property registration, mutation and land-record services through Haryana HARIS/HALRIS at tehsil and sub-tehsil level. The official DILRMP table for Panipat reports cadastral-map digitization status by tehsil, with zero entries in the georeferenced/RoR-linked columns at time of the table. No public full-geometry map endpoint or parcel-vector response schema was identified. The known HALRIS record lookup uses owner/khewat/khasra criteria, which were not queried.

India’s DILRMP district report confirms cadastral maps but indicates no maps are currently flagged as geo-referenced/linked to RoR in the listed Panipat tehsils; no anonymous parcel-feature service was verified.

searchQueries.result: First-party district and Haryana government sources confirm property registration, revenue records and map references. The reviewed map pages do not expose an anonymous full-parcel vector route; no parcel lookup by owner or title was made.
